title: What the Glasswing shows

is_this_you.pressure: Under strain you go clear and still, hoping trouble looks straight through you. Corner you, and the bitter part shows.
is_this_you.love: You get ready instead of giving chase. Then you wait in the shade and let what you made do the courting.
is_this_you.cost: People see through you so easily that some stop looking for you at all.

opener.text: In Spanish the glasswing is called espejitos, little mirrors [s5]. Most of each wing is clear [s5]. Tiny pillars stand on it, and they let the light pass and send back only a little [s6]. You were born a Cancer in a Goat year. People look at you and see their own face first.

howto: Three parts. Hold each one up to the light.

tabs.label: Clear wings
tabs.intro: Water with a shell. Earth with a needle in it.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, ruled by the Moon, protective and loyal for life once you are inside [s1] [s2]. The Goat is yin Earth, gentle and shy, soft outside and tough inside [s3] [s4]. The Chinese call that 綿裡藏針 (mián lǐ cáng zhēn), a needle hidden in silk floss [s15]. Anyone can see into you. The needle stays where it is.

The glasswing caterpillar feeds almost only on Cestrum, and larvae moved to other plants often die young [s5]. Care works on you the same way. A kind substitute, however well meant, will not feed you.
Translation and editing suit you, where meaning passes through clean. Nursing and home care suit the Cancer half. Glass, optics and fine design suit the Goat's patience.

In tests with related clearwing butterflies, the more transparent species were spotted later and less often [s7]. Being easy to see through can hide you. Say your limit out loud, and stop counting on being overlooked.

Before it changes, the caterpillar spins a small silk pad and hooks in [s5]. That hold is at least 50 times stronger than the chrysalis needs [s8]. You anchor first too. Only then do you let the old skin split.
Glasswing males gather in shaded leks and court with a scent they build from plant chemistry [s5]. You court the same way. You make something good, then you wait.

tabs.label: Who sees through you
tabs.intro: Three who stop and look. One who pulls the other way.
tabs.love_lead: In love you prepare more than you pursue. You need someone who notices what you made before you say a word. The old Chinese pairings give you three.

easy.why: The Capybara (Cancer, Pig year) stands in your Goat, Rabbit and Pig trine and shares your sign [s3] [s1].
The Green Sea Turtle (Cancer, Horse year) is your secret friend, since the Horse and the Goat are a six-harmony pair [s3].
The Moon Jellyfish (Pisces, Rabbit year) closes your trine, and Pisces is Water like Cancer [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Shoebill (Capricorn, Ox year): the Ox clashes with the Goat, and Capricorn sits opposite Cancer [s3] [s1].

story.text: Zhuang Zhou dreamed he was a butterfly and forgot he was Zhou [s10]. He woke and could not tell whether he had dreamed the butterfly or the butterfly was dreaming him [s10]. The chapter calls it 物化 (wù huà), the changing of things [s10]. It is told of butterflies in general, and it suits the clearest of them.

closing: Leave the wings clear. The ones worth keeping will look at you, not past you.
